items.description: Verify production monitoring covers auth errors, latency, token issuance, OTP sends, webhook delivery, SCIM sync, SSO failures, audit sink status, and provider callback failures.
Verify high-severity alerts route to the on-call owner with escalation for auth outage, key compromise, provider outage, webhook dead-letter growth, and audit sink failure.
Verify a customer-visible status page or equivalent incident communication channel exists for auth availability and provider-impacting incidents.
Run drills for signing key compromise, API key leak, OAuth provider compromise, webhook outage, audit sink failure, and account takeover.
Document and verify retention for users, sessions, devices, audit logs, webhook deliveries, SCIM sync state, OTP attempts, and deleted customer projects.
Verify production auth runtime releases require changelog, rollback plan, migration review, owner approval, and post-deploy smoke evidence.
Verify support can inspect users, sessions, devices, API keys, webhooks, audit events, and rate-limit buckets without direct database access.
Verify production, staging, and development use separate deployments, databases, domains, secrets, OAuth apps, email/SMS providers, and webhook endpoints.

Verify project setup wizard, redirect URI validation, provider setup checklists, environment separation, API key rotation, audit export, status page, and data retention policy before customer onboarding.
